assistant: Yes,   when using a fireplace, make sure to use a fireplace screen heavy enough to stop rolling logs and big enough to cover the entire opening of the fireplace to catch flying sparks, always make sure you have proper ventilation . Keep curtains, towels and potholders away from hot surfaces. Also, ensure that the fire is completely out before leaving the house or going to bed. In addition have a fire extinguisher and smoke detectors and make sure they work.

assistant: Sure, use only safe sources of alternative heat such as a fireplace, small well-vented wood or coal stove or portable space heaters. Always follow manufacturers’ instructions. When using alternative heat sources such as a fireplace or wood stove, always make sure you have proper ventilation. Keep curtains, towels and potholders away from hot surfaces. Have a fire extinguisher and smoke detectors and make sure they work. Make sure fuel space heaters are used with proper ventilation. It's also important to note that prolonged use of an open oven in a closed house can create carbon monoxide gas, so it's not recommended to use your gas oven to heat your home. Additionally, be aware of the signs of carbon monoxide poisoning and have a carbon monoxide detector installed in your home.
